tours.summary: Kupittaa platform -> stairs at the platform SE end -> covered Kalevansilta footbridge -> Joukahaisenkatu (zebra at ParkCity) -> EduCity Main Stairs (E corner) -> SE walkway -> east main entrance -> registration
Station hall street door (Tykistokatu side) -> Joukahaisenkatu -> Main Stairs -> east main entrance
ParkCity (Joukahaisenkatu 8) -> zebra -> Main Stairs -> SE walkway -> door B -> room 1002 (company arrivals)
Kupittaa platform -> EduCity door B → EduCity SE door B (company arrivals) -> east corridor -> room 1002 Moriaberg door
ParkCity -> ICT-City gateway (street level) -> EduCity lifts (TUAS barrier-free entrance)
Tykistokatu kerb (drop-off) -> BioCity Tykistokatu entrance → BioCity Tykistökatu door → main lobby → east ring corridor → Aulagalleria (Stand 1)
EduCity west main entrance -> raised deck (Stroget) past ICT-City -> Jussin aukio main stair (down ~10 steps) -> BioCity event entrance -> Aulagalleria -> build hall
Drop-off at the Tykistokatu kerb by the signalised junction -> BioCity entrance recess (past the supercars) -> main lobby -> Joki passage -> Aula -> ramp -> Showroom
ParkCity -> Joukahaisenkatu -> Tykistokatu sidewalk (BioCity side, past the Electrocity yard) -> entrance recess
Kupittaa station hall street door -> Tykistokatu (BioCity side) -> entrance recess
BioCity main lobby -> passage stair (10 treads down) -> Joki Aula / Cave (build areas) -> ramp -> Showroom
